description: Phase 2A for RSI_1h_edge_discovery: tune recent_width_atr and width_lookback_bars around working current widths w9/w11, using rails 2.15, 2.35, and transition-quality 2.45.
notes: Phase 1A found the main semantic current-width zone w9-w11.
Phase 1B showed that 2.45 is a valid transition-quality comparator, especially w11, while 2.50 is not included yet to keep Phase 2A compact and semantic/transition-focused.
Phase 2A sweeps current_width w9/w11, recent_width r8/r10/r12/r14, and width_lookback lb10/lb20/lb35.
No RSI blocker, RSI gate, ADX runner, runtime exits, BE, partial TP, trailing, HTF context, asymmetric rails, or wide continuation rails are included.
Question: which recent-width and lookback parameters stabilize the w9/w11 entry edge across semantic and transition-quality rails?
